Author:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>
AuthorDate: Sat Mar 7 16:38:08 2026 -0500
Commit:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>
CommitDate: Sat Mar 7 16:38:08 2026 -0500

    Bug 2021533 - Intermittent comm/mail/base/test/browser/menus/browser_folderPaneContext.js | testPropertiesSettingsFilters - account with key=account12 should be selected - "account13" == "account12". r=tobyp,jtracey
    
    
    The timeout may apparently not be enough to always ensure the selection is correct.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D286489

diff --git a/mail/base/test/browser/menus/browser_folderPaneContext.js b/mail/base/test/browser/menus/browser_folderPaneContext.js
index 3170138f914..e802362ce4a 100644
--- a/mail/base/test/browser/menus/browser_folderPaneContext.js
+++ b/mail/base/test/browser/menus/browser_folderPaneContext.js
@@ -548,7 +548,12 @@ add_task(async function testPropertiesSettingsFilters() {
     "about:accountsettings",
     "should show accountsettings"
   );
-  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve));
+  await TestUtils.waitForCondition(
+    () =>
+      browser.contentDocument.querySelector("#accounttree li.selected").id ==
+      account.key,
+    `account with key=${account.key} should get selected`
+  );
   Assert.equal(
     browser.contentDocument.querySelector("#accounttree li.selected").id,
     account.key,
